stories.title: Automated Meeting Ingestion
stories.iWantTo: Have my calendar meetings automatically synced and processed by the platform
stories.soThat: I can save time on manual entry and ensure all meeting context is captured
criteria: System successfully connects to Outlook/Google Calendar via OAuth
System creates a Meeting record upon sync
System triggers transcription workflow once the meeting starts
stories.techNotes: Requires integration with O365/Google Workspace APIs. Need a web hook listener for calendar updates.

stories.title: AI-Powered Action Extraction
stories.iWantTo: Have the system automatically extract action items from meeting transcripts
stories.soThat: I can focus on managing the project rather than documenting meeting minutes
criteria: System correctly identifies owner, due date, and task description
System maps extracted data to the defined JSON schema
System assigns status 'OPEN' by default upon creation
stories.techNotes: Use NER and Intent Classification via LLM. Post-process to map speakers to known user IDs.

stories.title: Action Item Status Updates
stories.iWantTo: Update the status of my assigned action items
stories.soThat: My project manager has visibility into my progress
criteria: Ability to transition status between OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED, and COMPLETED
Changes are logged in the system audit trail
Status changes are reflected in real-time dashboards
stories.techNotes: Expose PUT /api/v1/actions/{id} endpoint with status validation against the defined ENUM.

stories.title: Strategic Risk Detection
stories.iWantTo: Monitor meeting transcripts for high-level risks
stories.soThat: I can intervene early in projects that show signs of blockers or negative sentiment
criteria: System flags transcript segments as High, Medium, or Low risk
Executive dashboard displays aggregated risk levels across projects
System alerts when a 'Critical' risk is detected
stories.techNotes: Implement pattern matching and sentiment analysis on processed transcripts stored in the database.

stories.title: Semantic Knowledge Retrieval
stories.iWantTo: Query past meetings and decisions using natural language
stories.soThat: I can retrieve context from months of meetings without manually reading through transcripts
criteria: System accepts natural language search queries
Search results return relevant meeting segments
Vector search engine performs matching against stored embeddings
stories.techNotes: Leverage Qdrant for vector storage. Generate embeddings using 1536-dimensional model.

stories.title: Role-Based Access Control Implementation
stories.iWantTo: Define strict access policies based on user roles and meeting participation
stories.soThat: Sensitive organizational data remains private and secure
criteria: Users can only access meetings they participated in
PMs access is restricted to their project scope
Admin role provides global read/write access
MFA is required for all Manager/Admin login attempts
stories.techNotes: Enforce RBAC at the API middleware level. Use JWT claims to verify permissions on every request.

stories.title: Secure Audit Logging
stories.iWantTo: Review a detailed log of all administrative actions and AI queries
stories.soThat: I can maintain compliance and investigate potential security incidents
criteria: Every data export and system change is recorded
Audit logs include timestamp, User ID, and IP address
Logs are immutable and stored in the AuditLog table
stories.techNotes: Implement a database trigger or middleware to capture request context for the AuditLog table.
